name: imgflip-mcp
description: Browse Imgflip meme templates and generate memes through conversation.
long_description: Connects Claude to the Imgflip meme generator API. Ask for the most popular meme templates and have Claude caption them for you — from simple top/bottom text to multi-box templates with custom positioning and colors. A free Imgflip account is all you need; an optional Imgflip API Premium subscription unlocks template search, GIF captioning, automeme and AI meme generation.

imgflip_username.title: Imgflip username
imgflip_username.description: Username of your Imgflip account (a free account from https://imgflip.com/signup is enough)

imgflip_premium.title: Enable Premium tools
imgflip_premium.description: Only enable if your account has an Imgflip API Premium subscription — adds search_memes, get_meme, caption_gif, automeme and ai_meme

tools.name: get_memes
tools.description: List the ~100 most popular meme templates

tools.name: caption_image
tools.description: Caption a meme template and get the generated image URL

tools.name: get_meme
tools.description: Look up a single meme template by id (Premium)

tools.name: automeme
tools.description: Auto-pick a template for a piece of text (Premium)

tools.name: ai_meme
tools.description: Let Imgflip's AI invent a whole meme (Premium)
